newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares seen slowing, eyeing Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares seen slowing, eyeing Wall Street.

text.p: Gains for Singapore shares were seen slowing on Wednesday as institutional buying interest tapered off and Wall Street shares slipped, dealers said.
"We could see a bit of a sell down here after the slight correction on Wall Street last night," one dealer said.
Singapore's Straits Times Industrial's Index closed up 11.49 at 2,112.97 on Tuesday on the back of a last minute jump in index component stocks after a flat day's trade.
"I think technology stocks are still attractive and there's still retail interest in small cap stocks and new listings," another dealer said.
